content.text: Business is a focus on increasing Wealth and/or building structures. This can lead to gaining the Architect (+2 Stewardship, +1 Martial, -3% Great Construction Build Cost, -5% Great Construction Time) or Gardener (+2 Stewardship, +1 Learning).
It will always be a sea trade route unless the capital located in the Persia or Steppe region. Next event in 3 days if pursuing trade route.

items.text: 1 Preparations

children.text: A Hire crew Costs 1 year of income (min 25, max 200)

B Hire bandits Costs 40% (min 10, max 80) add Arbitrary . 20% chance of failing the expedition later (reduced to 15%, 11% and 8% if Intrigue equal or above to 8, 11 and 14), but will always grant experience. Can be worthwhile if seeking fast experience.
C Do nothing (end of event)

items.text: 2 Clergy wants to join If previously hired bandits, failure might happen in 7 days which will end the event. Otherwise next event in 14 days.

children.text: A Accept Gain 40% yearly income (min 5, max 80), next event in 14 days. May lead to trouble with host.
B No Dissapointed for 5 years, next event in 7 days.

items.text: 2* Clergy annoyed of bandits This event only happens if bandits were hired and the clergy joined, 10 days after heading out. Lose 15 Piety, can be avoided with 12 or more Diplomacy.
3 Arrival: presents gifts to host (next event in 7 days)

children.text: A Best gift (varies depending on religion, just flavour) -30 Wealth, +25 opinion ( Flattered ) of host ruler for 5 years
B Fine gift -15 Wealth, +10 opinion ( Fine Gift ) of host ruler for 3 years
C Small gift -5 Wealth
D Nothing -5 opinion ( Mildly disappointed ) of host ruler for 3 years

items.text: 4 Cultural differences

children.text: A Berate Steward , -15 opinion ( Angry ) for 1 year
B Disrespect culture , -5 opinion ( Disrepecting culture ) with host for 1 year
C Avoid either with a 10 Learning of more

items.text: 4* Clergy theological debate, endangering venture If priests were brought along and are not of the same religion as the host

children.text: A Berate priest -15 opinion ( Angry ) for 5 year
B Side with priest 50% of gaining Zealous trait, -5 opinion ( Religious quarrel ) with host for 1 year
C Avoid either with Gregarious trait

items.text: (HIDDEN) Calculate venture outcome

children.text: A Become friends with host, also venture success (won't happen if opinion below 0) Increased likelihood if opinion is or above 20 and 40 and Stewardship is or above 10 and 13. 50% chance of improving Stewardship education in 3 days. Next event in 7 days.

B Venture success Gain +10 opinion ( Trade Partner ) with host for 10 years. Increased likelihood if Stewardship is or above 10 and 13. 50% chance of improving Stewardship education in 3 days. Next event in 7 days.

C Become rivals with host, venture failure (won't happen if opinion is or above -10) Increased likelihood if opinion is or below -40 and -65. -30 opinion with host ( Grievously offended ) for 5 years. Host considers ruler a criminal and disables non-aggression pacts with ruler.

items.text: 5 Expedition outcome

children.text: A Success Gain 2 years and 6 months of yearly income (min 100, max 500), 150 Prestige, We're In Business achievement.  Add Trade route (+30% City tax, +20% Castle tax and Tribal Tax) modifier to capital for 30 years. May refresh modifier in 28 years (independent of ruler), costs 2 years and 6 months of yearly income (min 80, max 200), is repeatable. Not refreshing loses 25 Prestige. With , gain +6 Prosperity in capital. If not Architect or Gardener , gain Trader (+2 Stewardship) modifier. Also gain Business Contacts (+10 City Opinion) modifier. Reward Steward event in 5 days.
B Failure Gain Trader experience if not Architect or Gardener . End of event.

items.text: 6 Reward Steward? (last event)

children.text: Yes Give half a year of yearly income to Steward, +15 Opinion ( Grateful ) modifier for 5 years.
No 50% chance of gaining Greedy trait, -5 Opinion ( Disappointed ) modifier for 5 years.

content.text: First choice is whether to start building the tower or not. Next event in 7 days.

items.text: 1 Find a mason to do the stone details (Next event in 7 days)

children.text: A I know a craftsman that has the skill Cost 1 year of income. Creates courtier: 28 years old, Thrifty Clerk, Quick , Diligent , Lustful , Cynical , Gregarious , with 14/5/13/11/10 base attributes
B a street boy will do fine Cost 8% of yearly income. Requires Greedy . Creates courtier: 17 years old, Indulgent Wastrel, Humble , Slothful , Shy , Trusting , with 1/4/5/3/1 attributes

items.text: Up to 4 city vassals will react with +5 opinion ( Impressed ) for 2 years. Next event in 20 days.
2 More funding to lay out the plan (Next event in 7 days)

children.text: If hired craftsman , pay 1 year of income, avoidable if Intrigue equal or above 10.
If hired street boy , either pay 8% of yearly income, avoidable if not Cruel , 50% of becoming Cruel .

items.text: 3 Fix building materials

children.text: A Import the stone , cost 1 year of income. Next event in 5 days.
B Construct a Quarry , add Stone Quarry ( -25% Build Cost, -20% Build Time) province modifier for 80 years. With , gain +6 Prosperity in capital. Next event in 5 days.
C Recycle old building materials (requires Greedy ) cost 10 Wealth. Next event in 60 days.

items.text: 3* Accident at the construction site (only when chosing recycle old building materials)

children.text: A Add Construction Accident ( +5% Revolt Risk) province modifier for 1 year, gain Cruel . Next event in 120 days.
B Lose 6 months of income. Next event in 300 days.

items.text: 4 Bishop responds to tower (Skip to Construction Complete if dharmic or pagan religious groups)

children.text: A Bishop annoyed ( -10 clergy opinion) for 12 months. Next event in 60 days.
B I guess we can cut some meters of the top of the tower Happy -10 clergy opinion for 20 years. -50 Prestige. Next event in 60 days.
C I'm just following the words of 'God'. Requires Possessed . If not Zealous , gain trait. Next event in 60 days.
D He's onto me. He must disappear. Requires Lunatic . Next event in 3 days.
10% chance of character dying of accidental fall
90% chance of killing bishop, next event in 57 days

items.text: 5 Construction complete

children.text: A Gain Architect , remove Trader modifier, gain +100 Prestige Great Tower (+1 Prestige, +5 General Opinion) character modifier.
B gain +250 Prestige, Great Tower ( +1 Prestige, +5 General Opinion) character modifier.

content.text: If starting, next event in 7 days

items.text: 1 Clearing out weeds (next event in 28 days)

children.text: A I'll do it myself If not Slothful , 50% chance of becoming Diligent , lose Slothful
B Acquire a helping hand Make a courtier a friend
C Let the servants do it Requires Slothful , 50% chance of becoming Cruel

items.text: 2 Add statues (next event in 28 days)

children.text: A: of family members Costs 60% of yearly income. Gain Proud trait. Gain +5 Opinion ( Family Statues ) with dynasty members for 150 years.
B of religious leader (if not Muslim or not Iconoclast) Costs 60% of yearly income. Gain +5 Opinion ( Impressed ) with religious head and random priest for 10 years.
C no statues -25 Prestige

items.text: 3 Build fountain (next event in 28 days)

children.text: A Maze fountain Cost 1 year of yearly income, add Maze Fountain (+0.5 Prestige) modifier.

B Extravagant maze fountain (not Mulsim, except if Decadent ) Costs 3 year of yearly income, add Extravagant Maze Fountain (+1 Prestige) modifier. If not Temperate , 33% chance of becoming Gluttonous . Lose Temperate .
C No fountain

items.text: 4 Import flowers (next event in 28 days)

children.text: A Yes Costs 30% of yearly income. add maze_flowers flag.
B No

items.text: 5 Build pavilion (next event in 28 days)

children.text: A Yes Costs half a year income, add maze_pavilion flag.
B no

items.text: 6 Completion (reward calculation) magnificent_maze flag is set if at least 3 maze features were added. Cheapest choices: Statues (60% YI), Flowers (30% YI), Pavilion (50% YI). Total: 140% yearly income.

children.text: A Become Gardener , remove trader modifier, if magnificent_maze flag is set then gain Magnificent Maze (+1 Diplomacy) modifier
B Gain Aspiring Gardner (+1 Stewardship) modifier, remove trader modifier, if magnificent_maze flag is set then gain Magnificent Maze (+1 Diplomacy) modifier

items.text: A add Carpenter Guild ( -5% City Tax, -10% Build Cost, -20% Build Time) province modifier for 10 years
